hero.title:
Huerray
Every Hue. Every Story
hero.subtitle: We connect brands with creators from underrepresented communities to build authentic UGC that converts — culturally rich, emotionally real, and designed for today's social feeds.

why.title: Marketing that represents real people performs and feels better
why.description: At Huerray we believe inclusion isn't a checkbox: it's the creative standard. We help brands reach diverse audiences through content that's human, relatable and rooted in lived experience.

whatWeDo.title: We connect brands with creators who actually care about their products
whatWeDo.description: Huerray is a platform that matches brands with the perfect creators for authentic content. We handle everything from discovery to payment, so you can focus on what matters: creating great content.

items.title: Authenticity First
items.description: We believe in genuine connections between brands and creators

items.title: Fair Compensation
items.description: Creators deserve to be paid fairly for their work and influence

items.title: Transparency
items.description: Clear expectations and honest communication at every step

items.title: Quality Over Quantity
items.description: We focus on meaningful collaborations, not just numbers

story.title: Huerray is Rewriting the 2-3 Referrals Brands Attract and Connect at This End
story.subtitle: A journey from frustration to innovation
story.content: Founded by creators and marketers who experienced the pain points of influencer marketing firsthand, Huerray was built to solve real problems. We've created a platform that respects both brands and creators, making collaborations smoother, fairer, and more effective.

team.subtitle: Our Founding Story
team.title: Born in Berlin; founded by 3 friends from different corners of the world
team.description: Huerray grew from a simple observation: great creators were being overlooked because they didn't fit a narrow template. So we built a platform that makes visibility scalable — where creators are trusted to lead narratives and brands get content that actually connects.

members.name: Adedapo
members.bio: A business strategist from Nigeria, had spent years watching brilliant creators being overlooked — not because they lacked skill, but because they didn't fit the mold.

members.name: Norina
members.bio: A marketing mind from Austria with Indian roots, crafted campaigns for global brands yet rarely saw faces or stories that mirrored her own.
